text: Hello there ! Are you a newbie to this game? That's gonna be alright because I'm here to help you to achieve all the levels of this game.
In this game, your role is to reach the treasure with a couple of movements using direction keys or AWDS keys on your keyboard to move the character.
With 'W' is go up, 'D' is down, 'A' is left and 'S' is right.
I will introduce you more mechanics in the near future. So don't worry about it, just feel free to enjoy the game ^ ^ !
From this level onwards, there will be more and more obstacles appearing around the map. You can't get through them but they're really useful in some cases.
Learn how to make use of them and you can get the meow treasure easy as pie !!!
Hi there !! This is the last level of the first beta version. I hope that you like this game although there are still some weaknesses.
I will release the full version of this game with more fantastic gameplay and more level as soon as posible so that you could play freely.
Thanks for playing this game and Happy Women's Day !!!!!!!
